issues.message: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header. Enforces HTTPS connections. Add: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
Missing X-Content-Type-Options header. Prevents MIME type sniffing. Add: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
Missing X-Frame-Options header. Prevents clickjacking attacks. Add: X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN
Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header. Mitigates XSS and injection attacks. Configure a CSP header appropriate for your site.
Missing Referrer-Policy header. Controls referrer information. Add: Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
Missing Permissions-Policy header. Controls browser features. Add: Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS (got HTTP 200). Configure a 301 redirect from HTTP to HTTPS.

6 external link(s) with target='_blank' missing rel='noopener noreferrer'. This can expose your site to reverse tabnabbing attacks. Examples: Donate for Ramalaya, Mahasamadhi 2026 Camp, SriKrishna Parijatham Kuchipudi Dance
